lean.statement:
theorem integral_itoIntegralProcess_at_boundedStopping_eq_zero
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (eta : ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration mu T) (hT : 0 < T)
    (tau : Omega → ℝ≥0)
    (htau : IsChewiStoppingTime filtration
      (fun omega => (tau omega : WithTop ℝ≥0)))
    (htauT : ∀ omega, tau omega ≤ T)
    (hB : IsBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration mu)
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration mu) :
    ∫ omega, itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual (tau omega) omega ∂mu = 0
approved_definition_context: A filtration indexed by nonnegative reals is a monotone family of measurable subspaces on the sample space.
A ProgressiveL2Integrand is a real progressively measurable integrand with finite product-space L2 norm on the stated finite horizon.
An IsChewiStoppingTime condition says that every event where the nonnegative stopping time is at most a deterministic time is measurable at that time.
IsBrownianMotionWithFiltration supplies the real Brownian-motion contract relative to the displayed filtration and measure.
SatisfiesUsualConditions records completeness and right-continuity of the filtration.
itoIntegralProcess is the constructed completed continuous real Ito integral process; Integrable and the displayed integral are Mathlib Bochner-integral notions.
